text:
infra-bot: ALERT: KMS anomaly detected - key=redwood-prod-kms principal=svc-unknown@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com access=Decrypt count=34 window=5m confidence=0.87 https://alerts.internal/evt/12345
alice-sec: Opening war-room. @bob-sre @carol-ops @diane-eng @eric-sec-manager please join. Potential privilege escalation using KMS key.
bob-sre: Joining. Pulling CloudAudit + KMS logs now.
carol-ops: Putting deploy freeze on prod and pausing CI that references redwood-prod-kms :no_entry_sign:
diane-eng: Noted. svc-payment-writer SA last key rotation 180d. Listing active keys and bound principals, will post findings.
bob-sre: Logs: ```2026-03-20T12:00:05Z KMS Encrypt key=redwood-prod-kms principal=svc-unknown@... proto=grpc request_id=xyz``` multiple distinct IPs. Correlating with VM metadata.
alice-sec: Can we revoke the service account tokens that referenced this key immediately? If unknown principal isn't our SA, revoke trust.
carol-ops: I can remove the IAM binding for the key for all non-approved principals (quick revoke) - doing `gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding` now. Will stage a key disable if revoke doesn't reduce hits.
bob-sre: I see the principal is not in org list, looks like an ex-employee SA or leaked key. Creating temporary deny policy on key to block decrypts. Command snippet: ```gcloud kms keys set-iam-policy redwood-prod-kms deny-policy.json```
diane-eng: Confirmed one compute VM had metadata with a long-lived token referencing that SA. Isolating VM and snapshotting disk for forensics.
alice-sec: Good. Action list so far: 1) revoke bindings (carol) 2) isolate VM & snapshot (diane) 3) rotate affected KMS key / create replacement key and re-encrypt critical data (bob + ops) 4) enable verbose audit logging for KMS and IAM (alice).
carol-ops: Revoked non-org principals. Traffic to key dropped from 34->2 in last 3m. Still some remaining requests originating from 10.12.32.11 (isolated VM).
bob-sre: Spinning new key redwood-prod-kms-v2, updating temporary fallback policy to route decrypts to v2 for verified services. Plan for rolling re-encrypt after containment.
eric-sec-manager: Heads up for stakeholders: I'll notify legal + CTO and prepare initial incident communication. @alice-sec compile timeline and evidence for next update.
alice-sec: Putting a short timeline in the thread: "12:00 infra-bot alert, 12:02 war-room, 12:04 revoke bindings, 12:08 isolate VM, 12:12 rotate key start". Adding links to logs + snapshots.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident INC-20260320-42 acknowledged by alice-sec. Escalation policy IT-Sec invoked.
diane-eng: Snapshot complete, copying disk image to forensics bucket (retention=90d). No sign of lateral movement on other hosts so far.
bob-sre: Started re-encrypt job to migrate secrets to redwood-prod-kms-v2 using safe window and throttling. Monitoring for failures.
alice-sec: Quick vuln triage: check RBAC audit for any recent policy changes that would allow external SA creation. Also search git for infra-as-code PRs touching IAM in last 30d.
eric-sec-manager: I'm taking command for the overnight handoff at 13:00 UTC. @alice-sec assume post-incident lead for remediation (RBAC cleanup, rotation proof, audit logs retention). Please prepare a 1-pager summary and list of required follow-ups.
alice-sec: Will do. Immediate follow-ups: full RBAC audit, rotate any long-lived SA keys older than 90d, add CI checks to prevent new long-lived tokens, update runbook to include deny-before-rotate for KMS anomalies.
carol-ops: Leaving ops on-call: @diane-eng will continue monitoring re-encrypt/rollout. I'll stay reachable for rollback.
diane-eng: Monitoring: re-encrypt at 12% done, no decrypt errors. Network ACLs applied to isolated VM. Forensics team pulling artifacts now.
eric-sec-manager: Handoff notes for night team: evidence links: https://forensics.internal/evt/12345, logs: https://logs.internal/kms/1782345600, snapshots: gs://forensics/incident-20260320. Primary owner overnight: eric-sec-manager. Oncall contact: pagerduty. Next update by 18:00 UTC.
alice-sec: Thanks team. Will produce incident artifacts and start postmortem template. Tagging follow-ups in backlog: RBAC cleanup, KMS audit retention increase, SA rotation policy. :white_check_mark:
carol-ops: Confirmed deploy freeze lifted for unaffected services; leaving freeze on anything referencing old key until re-encrypt completes.
eric-sec-manager: Acknowledged handoff. If any new anomalies, escalate to full incident commander. Good job everyone.
